Busayrah is also associated with the concept of isti'zal, or independence, and is said to be a woman who values her freedom and autonomy. In Islamic tradition, Busayrah is also associated with the concept of sabr, or patience, and is said to be a woman who is able to endure hardships and difficulties with equanimity. Additionally, Busayrah is associated with the concept of 'ilm, or knowledge, and is said to be a woman who is wise and discerning in her actions and decisions.
